LocalDataStorage
Description
Using the AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_ID as ID argument of the IAIMPServiceMusicLibrary.GetStorageByID method, you will get an low level access to the "Local Files" data storage.
Usage example
Excerpt from MusicLibraryBrowserDemo:
<IAIMPServiceMusicLibrary>.GetStorageByID(<AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_ID>, IID_IAIMPMLDataStorage2, DataStorage);
     
  if Supports(DataStorage, IAIMPMLDataProvider, DataProvider) then
  begin
    CoreCreateObject(IID_IAIMPObjectList, FieldList);
    FieldList.Add(<AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_FILENAME>);
         
    DataStorage.CreateObject(IID_IAIMPMLDataFilter, FieldFilter);
    FieldFilter.Add(<AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_ARTIST>, "ArtistName", Null, AIMPML_FIELDFILTER_OPERATION_EQUALS);
    FieldFilter.SetValueAsInt32(AIMPML_FILTERGROUP_OPERATION, AIMPML_FILTERGROUP_OPERATION_AND);
    
    if Succeeded(DataProvider.GetData(FieldList, Filter, Data)) then
    begin
      if Supports(Data, IAIMPMLDataProviderSelection, ASelection) then
      repeat
        SetString(FileName, ASelection.GetValueAsString(0, Length), Length);
        //.. do something with FileName
      until not ASelection.NextRow;
    end;
  end;
We recommends to execute all code that works with the DataProvider from non-main threads to prevent UI from freezing. Do not forget about the IAIMPTaskOwner when using threading.
Available Fields
AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_ID
ID of file in database
TypeInt32
AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_ADDDED
Date and time of adding file to database
TypeFloat

Integer part is days, fractional part is milliseconds.
Time format is fully compatible with TDateTime type from Delphi language
AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_ALBUM
Album
TypeString
ValueMultiple values split by ";" character
AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_ALBUMARTIST
Album Artist
TypeString
ValueMultiple values split by ";" character
AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_ARTIST
Artist
TypeString
ValueMultiple values split by ";" character
AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_BITDEPTH
Information about bit depth of audio stream.
= 0 - bit depth is unknown
< 0 - corresponds to floating point sample type.
TypeInt32
AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_BITRATE
Bitrate in kbps
TypeInt32
AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_BPM
Beats per minute
TypeInt32
AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_CHANNELS
Number of channels
TypeInt32
AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_CATALOG
Catalog Key
TypeString
ValueSingle
AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_COMMENT

TypeString
ValueMultiline
AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_COMPOSER

TypeString
ValueMultiple values split by ";" character

AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_GENRE
Genre

AIMPML_LOCALDATASTORAGE_FIELD_LABELS
Custom labels

    AIMP_RA_CMD_GET_ALBUMART
    AIMP_RA_CMD_GET_ALBUMART
    This command is provided for an ability to get album art for playing file.

    There are two stages:
    1st - external application sends request to the player
    2nd - player receive it and sends the answer back as WM_COPYDATA message

    LParam of the WM_COPYDATA message contained pointer to the CopyDataStruct structure which will contains followed data:
    • dwData - Signature, must be = WM_AIMP_COPYDATA_ALBUMART_ID
    • lpData - Pointer to first element of byte array that contained data of Album Art image in PNG format
    • cbData - Length of data array
    inParamLPARAM Handle of window that will receive the answer.
    outResultLRESULT Return 0 if player is stopped or album art is not presented for playing file

    Example
    Refer to the Demos\RemoteAccessDemo folder
    Warning
    This command is working only for 32-bit applications

    Overview
    Overview
    All Local API was based on interfaces. if you are not familiar with it, please refer to this article.

    Note that some programming languages doesn't interact with reference counter of the interface automatically (Delphi not related to this category of programming languages) - see Microsoft recommendations.
    Structure
    All interactions between program and plugin processed via their presenters - IAIMPCore and IAIMPPlugin respectively.
    IAIMPCore provides an access to already presented functionality of program (including functionality that implemented via other plugins).
    IAIMPPlugin produces a new functionality or extend existing.

    Services is interfaces that provides an access to functions grouped by target. Each service presents specific part of program or plugin. Name of interface of service always looks like IAIMPServiceXXX. For example: IAIMPServiceMenuManager, IAIMPServiceActionManager.

    Extensions is interfaces that extends an existing services. Name of interface is in the IAIMPExtensionXXX format. For example: IAIMPExtensionAudioDecoder, IAIMPExtensionFileInfoProvider.
    Definitions
    In this documentation uses the following definitions:
    1. Value quoted in "<" ">" means a instance of the interface. For example: <IAIMPCore>
    Multi-threading
    Note that only few services are supports multi-threading. Description for each interface contains information about multi-threading support.
    See also
  • Plugin work folder structure
  • An access to services
  • Guidelines for working with services

  • Registering service

    Free Audio Player
    www.aimp.ru
    Custom localizations
    Description
    Plugin must place all custom localization files in the "Langs" sub folder of own work folder in the *.lng format. The LNG format is simple INI-file.

    All localizations automatically loads by engine and merges with base localization. You can get an access to merged localization via IAIMPServiceMUI service.

    Automatic loading is performed by the following rules:
    1. Engine trying to load file with same name as base localization from the <PluginWorkPath>\Langs folder.
    2. If file is not found - engine trying to load English.lng
    3. If file is not found - engine trying to load Russian.lng
    4. Content of custom localization merges in memory (content of files will not changed) with base localization without replacing the identical keys.
    © Artem Izmaylov, 2006-2026
    Free Audio Player
    www.aimp.ru
    Creating custom services
    Requirements to custom services
    1. Each interface (service, object or etc) must have unique GUID
    2. GUID must not be equals to GUID of standard interfaces
    3. Strictly forbidden to change structure of any interface without changing it GUID, if interface has been published at least once
    Custom Extensions
    1. Service must implement IAIMPServiceAttrExtendable* interface if it want to support extensions
    2. Service must not implement own version of extensions registration mechanism.
    3. All extensions must be registered via IAIMPCore.RegisterExtension. This will allow to application to track relationships between plugins and unregister extensions automatically before plugin unload
    Registering Primitives
    Service must implement IAIMPServiceAttrObjects* interface if it want to share own primitives for itself and other plugins. According to this other plugins will be able to access to primitives via IAIMPCore.CreateObject method.
    Registering Services
    To registering custom service call the IAIMPCore.RegisterService method during plugin initialization. Custom service will be unregistered automatically before plugin finalization.
    Example
    Refer to the Demos \ CustomServiceDemo
    * All required interfaces are defined in the apiCore.

    Common Terms
    AIMP works with two file types - real and virtual.

    Virtual file is file that does not really exists on drive in the form in which it looks for the program. Usually, virtual file is representation of real file in the archive or representation of some part of real file.

    Name of virtual file is meta-link to the file-container and track name in the following format:
      <Full path to file-container>:<full track name>
    Note 1: full track name can contains the "/" or "\" symbols, but must not contains the ":" symbol.
    Note 2: full track name must not be started from the "/", "\" symbols
    Note 3: name of file-container must not be ended by the "/", "\" symbols.

    Examples:
      C:\Music\MyTrack 1.ogg:02
      C:\Music\MyTrack 2.ogg:03_chapter001
      C:\Music\MyTrack 3.cue:15
      C:\Music\MyTrack 4.cue:subtrack 1/chapter 001

    Note, that file container can be an audio file or any other, including really nonexistent.

    Note: in this API, names of virtual files will be marked as FileURI, names of real files - as FileName.

    Overview
    Overview
    Album arts can be so different: as small as too large. They can be placed locally or downloaded from the Internet. To prevent app from freezing while track's album art is loading, the AIMP has uses few solutions:

    1. Image optimization

    Large album arts resizes to optimal size for display. What reason to display image in 10 MPx resolution on Full HD screen?

    2. Requests caching

    Optimized album art copies are stored in app cache. This lead that second attempt to take an album art will be completed so fast. Cache can be flushed by plugin via special API (refer to IAIMPServiceAlbumArtCache), or by end user via special UI in app settings.

    In v5.02, we have re-designed caching mechanism: now each album art provider MUST interact with caching system by itself. This decision was made because only the provider know what file information is used to search the album art and if requests must be cached or not. Refer to IAIMPAlbumArtRequest for more details.
    © Artem Izmaylov, 2006-2026
    Free Audio Player
    www.aimp.ru

    Methods
    CacheGet
    Returns the IAIMPImageContainer for specified key.
    Note that Image may set to nil / null event if function succeeded.
    inKeyIAIMPStringThe key must be built to uniquely identify the album art for the specified IAIMPFileInfo.
    varImageIAIMPImageContainer
    outResultHRESULT S_OK - The method was successfully completed
    E_FAIL - cache has no entry for the Key
    E_ACCESSDENIED - cache is disabled due app settings or search options
    E_UNEXPECTED - An unexpected failure occurred
    CachePut
    Optimizes the IAIMPImageContainer and put it to cache.
    You can put the nil / null to Image parameter to cache an empty value for the key.

    inKeyIAIMPStringThe key must be built to uniquely identify the album art for the specified IAIMPFileInfo.
    varImageIAIMPImageContainer Method will return optimized version of the Image if the AIMP_SERVICE_ALBUMART_FLAGS_ORIGINAL flag is not specified in search options.
    outResultHRESULT S_OK - The method was successfully completed
    E_UNEXPECTED - An unexpected failure occurred
    Download
    This is helper function that make download images easier.
    The method take the AIMP_ALBUMART_REQUEST_PROPID_FIND_IN_INTERNET and AIMP_ALBUMART_REQUEST_PROPID_FIND_IN_INTERNET_MAX_FILE_SIZE options into account by itself.
    inURLIAIMPString Following protocols are supported: file:// and http(s)://
    outImageIAIMPImageContainer
    outResultHRESULT S_OK - The method was successfully completed
    E_FAIL - The method was failed
    E_ABORT - The operation was canceled by a user
    E_ACCESSDENIED - an ability to download album arts from the Internet has been disabled by app settings or search options
    E_OUTOFMEMORY - image size exceed limit that defined by the AIMP_ALBUMART_REQUEST_PROPID_FIND_IN_INTERNET_MAX_FILE_SIZE option
    E_UNEXPECTED - An unexpected failure occurred
    IsCanceled
    This is tool interface that provides an ability to plugin to be notified about canceling the operation
    outResultLongBool Plugin must break the operation if the method returns True.
    Usage example
    Here is a small example that show how to interact with IAIMPAlbumArtRequest. The example downloads the image that defined as URL in corresponding tag field:

    function Get(FileInfo: IAIMPFileInfo; Request: IAIMPAlbumArtRequest; out Image: IAIMPImageContainer): HRESULT; stdcall;
    var
      ALink: IAIMPString;
    begin
      Result := E_FAIL;
      // Is file info has a url?
      if PropListGetStr(FileInfo, AIMP_FILEINFO_PROPID_URL, ALink) then
      begin 
        // Is image url? 
        if IsImageURL(ALink) then 
        begin
          // Is image already cached? 
          if Succeeded(Request.CacheGet(ALink, Image)) then
            Exit(S_OK);
            
          // Download the image
          // The Download function will consider values of the 
          // AIMP_ALBUMART_REQUEST_PROPID_FIND_IN_INTERNET and AIMP_ALBUMART_REQUEST_PROPID_FIND_IN_INTERNET_MAX_FILE_SIZE options
          if Succeeded(Request.Download(ALink, Image)) then
          begin
            // Optimize the image and cache it 
            Request.CachePut(ALink, Image);
            Result := S_OK;
          end;
        end;
      end;
    end;

    IAIMPAudioDecoder
    Methods
    GetFileInfo
    Method provides an meta-data for decoding file or stream.

    Decoder may not implement this method, in this case the application will try to get information about decoding file via another file info provides. You must return the False value.

    Attention! In implementation of this method you must not call the GetFileInfo* methods of the IAIMPServiceFileInfo service.
    inFileInfoIAIMPFileInfo
    outResultLongBool True - if the FileInfo parameter was populated by decoder
    GetStreamInfo
    Method provides an information about the audio stream
    outSampleRateIntegerSampling rate
    outChannelsIntegerCount of channels
    outSampleFormatInteger Sample format of uncompressed data, can be one of following values:
    • AIMP_DECODER_SAMPLEFORMAT_08BIT
    • AIMP_DECODER_SAMPLEFORMAT_16BIT
    • AIMP_DECODER_SAMPLEFORMAT_24BIT
    • AIMP_DECODER_SAMPLEFORMAT_32BIT
    • AIMP_DECODER_SAMPLEFORMAT_32BITFLOAT
    • AIMP_DECODER_SAMPLEFORMAT_64BITFLOAT (since v5.40)
    outResultLongBool
    IsSeekable
    This flag defines if seeking support by decoder or not
    outResultLongBool
    IsRealTimeStream
    This flag defines if is real-time stream or not.
    outResultLongBool
    GetAvailableData
    Count of available data for read in bytes in format of uncompressed data.
    In general cases, this value should be equal to GetSize - GetPosition.
    outResultInt64
    GetSize
    Duration in bytes in format of uncompressed data.
    can be equal to zero, if the IsSeekable or/and the IsRealTimeStream method returns the True value
    outResultInt64
    GetPosition
    Current position in bytes in format of uncompressed data.
    outResultInt64
    SetPosition
    inValueInt64 New position in bytes in format of uncompressed data.
    outResultLongBool
    Read
    inBufferPByte
    inCountInteger Number of bytes to be read
    outResultInteger Number of read bytes
    Note 1
    The interface implementation must support asynchronous access.
    Note 2
    Note that all sizes are defined in PCM format of uncompressed data.

    Example:
    The GetStreamInfo method return following values for parameters: SampleRate = 44100, Channels = 2, SampleFormat = AIMP_DECODER_SAMPLEFORMAT_16BIT. So, in this case the GetPosition method will return following value for 1 second: 1 * 44100 * 2 * (16 / 8) = 176400 bytes.
    Creating the instance
    Instance of decoder creates by the IAIMPExtensionAudioDecoder or the IAIMPExtensionAudioDecoderOld extension via calling the CreateDecoder method

    IAIMPExtensionAlbumArtProvider3
    Description
    The IAIMPExtensionAlbumArtProvider3 interface is a extension for the IAIMPServiceAlbumArt service, and allows to plugin implement custom album art provider.

    Interface implementation must support asynchronous access.
    Methods
    Get
    inFileInfoIAIMPFileInfo
    inRequestIAIMPAlbumArtRequestSearch options, refer to the properties of the IAIMPServiceAlbumArt service topic for more information.

    Attention! You must check the current options before start the search. Extension must return the E_FAIL code if options does not match to the requirements for search.

    Here is a small example that show how to interact with IAIMPAlbumArtRequest. The example downloads the image that defined as URL in corresponding tag field:

    function Get(FileInfo: IAIMPFileInfo; Request: IAIMPAlbumArtRequest; out Image: IAIMPImageContainer): HRESULT; stdcall;
    var
      ALink: IAIMPString;
    begin
      Result := E_FAIL;
      // Is file info has a url?
      if PropListGetStr(FileInfo, AIMP_FILEINFO_PROPID_URL, ALink) then
      begin 
        // Is image url? 
        if IsImageURL(ALink) then 
        begin
          // Is image already cached? 
          if Succeeded(Request.CacheGet(ALink, Image)) then
            Exit(S_OK);
            
          // Download the image
          // The Download function will consider values of the 
          // AIMP_ALBUMART_REQUEST_PROPID_FIND_IN_INTERNET and AIMP_ALBUMART_REQUEST_PROPID_FIND_IN_INTERNET_MAX_FILE_SIZE options
          if Succeeded(Request.Download(ALink, Image)) then
          begin
            // Optimize the image and cache it 
            Request.CachePut(ALink, Image);
            Result := S_OK;
          end;
        end;
      end;
    end;
    outImageIAIMPImageContainer
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - If success, any other value otherwise
    GetCategory
    Returns provider category.
    outResultDWORD One of the following values:
  • AIMP_ALBUMART_PROVIDER_CATEGORY_TAGS - artwork extracts from the file tags


  • AIMP_ALBUMART_PROVIDER_CATEGORY_FILE - artwork loads from physical file (Example: cover.jpg that placed in near the audio file)


  • AIMP_ALBUMART_PROVIDER_CATEGORY_INTERNET - artwork downloads from network


  • AIMP_ALBUMART_PROVIDER_CATEGORY_INTERNET_SEARCH - artwork downloads from network, indicates that the AIMP_ALBUMART_REQUEST_PROPID_RESULTS is supported by the provider (since v5.40)
    • Creating instance
    Instance should be created by plugin and must be registered in the application in the plugin initialization method via the IAIMPCore.RegisterExtension method.

    IAIMPExtensionAudioDecoder
    Description
    The IAIMPExtensionAudioDecoder interface is extension for the IAIMPServiceAudioDecoders service.

    Interface implementation must support asynchronous access.
    Methods
    CreateDecoder
    inStreamIAIMPStream
    inFlagsDWORD0 or combination of following flags:
  • AIMP_DECODER_FLAGS_FAST_SEEKING - flag allows the decoder to use inaccurate seeking in IAIMPAudioDecoder.SetPosition. Flag is used to calculate waveform-navigator.
  • AIMP_DECODER_FLAGS_FORCE_CREATE_INSTANCE - the flag was designed for decoders that not support multi-instance decoding. If this flag is defined plugin must drop all active decoders for an ability to create new instance of decoder
    • inErrorInfoIAIMPErrorInfoInformation about the error. Should be populated by plugin if error occurs.

    Parameter can be nil / null.

    Warning! Plugin must not populate the error info, if it was not detect in the Stream or File supported file format.
    outDecoderIAIMPAudioDecoder Decoder Instance
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - If success, any other value otherwise
    E_PENDING - Decoder instance cannot be created because another instance of decoder is already active (this error code must be used only for decoders that are not support multi-instance decoding)
    Creating instance
    Instance should be created by plugin and must be registered in the application in the plugin initialization method via the IAIMPCore.RegisterExtension method.

    Together with this interface plugin should implement and register the IAIMPExtensionFileFormat interface. This interface will allow Application to know about the new formats.

    IAIMPExtensionAudioDecoderOld
    Description
    The IAIMPExtensionAudioDecoderOld interface unlike the IAIMPExtensionAudioDecoder provides an ability to create decoder based on real or virtual name of file instead of IAIMPStream.

    This extension is obsolete, it has been provided for compatibility purposes for old designed decoders that are not support custom streams. Plugin must avoid to use it, because in this case following functions will be unavailable for end user: file caching, an ability to play sub tracks from set / archive and etc.

    Interface implementation must support asynchronous access.
    Methods
    CreateDecoder
    inFileNameIAIMPString Real or virtual full file name.
    inFlagsDWORD0 or combination of following flags:
  • AIMP_DECODER_FLAGS_FAST_SEEKING - flag allows the decoder to use inaccurate seeking in IAIMPAudioDecoder.SetPosition. Flag is used to calculate waveform-navigator.
  • AIMP_DECODER_FLAGS_FORCE_CREATE_INSTANCE - the flag was designed for decoders that not support multi-instance decoding. If this flag is defined plugin must drop all active decoders for an ability to create new instance of decoder
    • inErrorInfoIAIMPErrorInfoInformation about the error. Should be populated by plugin if error occurs.

    Parameter can be nil / null.

    Warning! Plugin must not populate the error info, if it was not detect in the Stream or File supported file format.
    outDecoderIAIMPAudioDecoder Decoder Instance
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - If success, any other value otherwise

    Creating instance
    Instance should be created by plugin and must be registered in the application in the plugin initialization method via the IAIMPCore.RegisterExtension method.

    Together with this interface plugin should implement and register the IAIMPExtensionFileFormat interface. This interface will allow Application to know about the new formats.

    IAIMPExtensionEmbeddedVisualization
    Description
    This is extension for the IAIMPServiceVisualizations service. This type visualization displays on visual display of player only and can be chosen by user.
    Methods
    GetFlags
    outResultInteger Returns zero or combination of followed flags:
    • AIMP_VISUAL_FLAGS_RQD_DATA_WAVEFORM - plugin required WaveForm data for rendering
    • AIMP_VISUAL_FLAGS_RQD_DATA_SPECTRUM - plugin required Spectrum data for rendering
    • AIMP_VISUAL_FLAGS_NOT_SUSPEND - rendering must not be suspended even if the VisualDisplay window is hidden or inaccessible
    • AIMP_VISUAL_FLAGS_ACTION_EXTRA - plugin supports for extra actions (Down/Move/Leave), (since v6.0)
    • AIMP_VISUAL_FLAGS_ACTION_DOUBLE_CLICK - plugin has custom implementation of action on double click via left mouse button, (since v6.0)
    • AIMP_VISUAL_FLAGS_ACTION_WHEEL - plugin supports for mouse wheel, (since v6.0)
    GetMaxDisplaySize
    Method returns a maximal resolution supported by the extension. If current resolution is not supported by extension, player will automatically stretch output.
    outWidthInteger Maximal width
    outHeightInteger Maximal height
    outResultHRESULT S_OK - if success
    E_FAIL - if extension have no maximal size limitation
    GetName
    outSIAIMPString Friendly name
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - If success, any other value otherwise
    Initialize
    inWidthInteger Width of visualization display.
    Note that display size can be changing via IAIMPExtensionEmbeddedVisualization.Resize method.
    inHeightInteger Height of visualization display.
    Note that display size can be changing via IAIMPExtensionEmbeddedVisualization.Resize method.
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - If success, any other value otherwise
    Finalize
    Visualization should free all unneeded resources, but note that visualization can be initialized again - you must not finalize the plugin at all.

    This method called when user switched to other visualization or switch off visualizations
    Action
    User interaction with the visualization display
    inXInteger
    inYInteger
    inActionInteger
  • AIMP_VISUAL_ACTION_CLICK - left mouse button click
  • AIMP_VISUAL_ACTION_CLICK_MIDDLE - middle mouse button click
  • AIMP_VISUAL_ACTION_CLICK_DOUBLE - double click via left mouse button, only if AIMP_VISUAL_FLAGS_ACTION_DOUBLE_CLICK is defined in GetFlags (since v6.0)
  • AIMP_VISUAL_ACTION_DOWN - pressing the left mouse button (a "Click" event will be triggered upon release), only if AIMP_VISUAL_FLAGS_ACTION_EXTRA is defined in GetFlags (since v6.0)
  • AIMP_VISUAL_ACTION_MOVE - mouse movement over the display, only if AIMP_VISUAL_FLAGS_ACTION_EXTRA is defined in GetFlags (since v6.0)
  • AIMP_VISUAL_ACTION_LEAVE - mouse exit from the display area, only if AIMP_VISUAL_FLAGS_ACTION_EXTRA is defined in GetFlags (since v6.0)
  • AIMP_VISUAL_ACTION_WHEEL_DOWN/UP - mouse wheel action, only if AIMP_VISUAL_FLAGS_ACTION_WHEEL is defined in GetFlags (since v6.0)

    IAIMPExtensionPlaybackQueue
    Description
    This extension provides an ability to override internal playback queue.

    Warning! Next / previous track must be calculated based on value of the Current parameter. In general, it may not match the currently playing track. Also, player can request information about next / previous track several times.

    Plugin must not take into account the value of the AIMP_PLAYLISTITEM_PROPID_PLAYINGSWITCH property of theIAIMPPlaylistItem during search of next / previous track, this parameter will be checked automatically on player side.
    Methods
    GetNext
    Event occurs when player is looking for next track for playback
    inCurrentIUnknown Current position in queue from which the next one is calculated (see flags)
    In general, it may not match the currently playing track.
    inFlagsDWORD The flags shows, how value of the Current parameter must be interpreted.
    For Now, the Flags parameter can contains one of following values:
    • AIMP_PLAYBACKQUEUE_FLAGS_START_FROM_BEGINNING - queue should return first item in the playlist. The Current is IAIMPPlaylist
    • AIMP_PLAYBACKQUEUE_FLAGS_START_FROM_CURSOR - queue should return item next after the playback cursor. The Current is IAIMPPlaylist
    • AIMP_PLAYBACKQUEUE_FLAGS_START_FROM_ITEM - queue should return item next after the Current. The Current is IAIMPPlaylistItem
    inQueueItemIAIMPPlaybackQueueItem Interface instance that contains information about the track. Must be populated on plugin side.
    outResultLongBool False - queue is switched off.

    Note that even if the queue could not find the record suitable to search parameters, this method must populate the QueueItem parameter and return the True value as result.

    GetPrev
    Event occurs when player is looking for previous track for playback
    inCurrentIUnknown Current position in queue from which the previous one is calculated (see flags)
    In general, it may not match the currently playing track.
    inFlagsDWORD The flags shows, how value of the Current parameter must be interpreted.
    For Now, the Flags parameter can contains one of following values:
    • AIMP_PLAYBACKQUEUE_FLAGS_START_FROM_BEGINNING - queue should return last item in the playlist. The Current is IAIMPPlaylist
    • AIMP_PLAYBACKQUEUE_FLAGS_START_FROM_CURSOR - queue should return item previous before the playback cursor. The Current is IAIMPPlaylist
    • AIMP_PLAYBACKQUEUE_FLAGS_START_FROM_ITEM - queue should return item previous before the Current. The Current is IAIMPPlaylistItem
    inQueueItemIAIMPPlaybackQueueItem Interface instance that contains information about the track. Must be populated on plugin side.
    outResultLongBool False - queue is switched off.

    Note that even if the queue could not find the record suitable to search parameters, this method must populate the QueueItem parameter and return the True value as result.

    OnSelect
    Event occurs when playback of the Item is started. Plugin must not change properties of the Item.
    inItemIAIMPPlaylistItem
    inQueueItemIAIMPPlaybackQueueItem
    Creating instance
    Instance should be created by plugin and must be registered in the application in the plugin initialization method via the IAIMPCore.RegisterExtension method.

    IAIMPExtensionPlaylistShuffler
    Description
    This extension provides plugin an ability to register custom shuffler algorithm that used to build shuffled playback queue.
    Method
    Shuffle
    The method will be invoked each time when need to update playback queue indexes in the playlist.
    Usually it happened after:
  • Adding new files
  • Recreating the queue
  • Queue has been modified by user (for example, user has started some track manually)
    • inPlaylistIAIMPPlaylist
    inItemsIAIMPObjectList2 List of IAIMPPlaylistItem to update the AIMP_PLAYLISTITEM_PROPID_PLAYBACKQUEUEINDEX property.

    Note: list may contains not all track from the playlist, only the tracks to update. In this case, the InitialIndex property will specify a starting playback queue index for the items. Indexes must be unique and must not be below the InitialIndex. This was made to prevent tracks repeations while playing the playlist.
    inInitialIndexInteger Starting playback queue index for the items. Indexes must be unique and must not be below the InitialIndex
    outResultHRESULT Return S_OK if plugin has succeeded update playback queue indexes of the items. Any other result code will be treated as transferring to default algorithm.

    IAIMPFileSystemCommandStreaming
    Description
    Command creates the IAIMPStream for specified FileName.

    Interface implementation must support asynchronous access.
    Methods
    CreateStream
    Creates the IAIMPStream interface for specified real file.
    inFileNameIAIMPStringReal file name
    inFlagsDWORD Combination of following flags:
    • AIMP_SERVICE_FILESTREAMING_FLAG_CREATENEW - create or overwrite file
    • AIMP_SERVICE_FILESTREAMING_FLAG_READ - open an existing file for reading
    • AIMP_SERVICE_FILESTREAMING_FLAG_READWRITE - open an existing file for reading or writing
    • AIMP_SERVICE_FILESTREAMING_FLAG_BUFFERED - pre-buffer read/write operation for better performance
    inOffsetInt64 The Offset and the Size parameters allows to create stream for part of file.
    If you not need that, both parameters should be set to -1.

    This feature does not compatible with the AIMP_SERVICE_FILESTREAMING_FLAG_CREATENEW and AIMP_SERVICE_FILESTREAMING_FLAG_READWRITE flags.
    inSizeInt64 Refer to the Offset.
    outStreamIAIMPStream
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - The method was successfully completed
    E_INVALIDARG - One of the arguments is not valid
    E_NOTIMPL - The method is not implemented
    E_UNEXPECTED - An unexpected failure occurred

    IAIMPHTTPClientEvents
    Description
    This interface allows to plugin receive notifications from active asynchronous task.

    All notifications will be called from main thread if the AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_ASYNC flag is not specified.
    Methods
    OnAccept
    Event occurs when active task receives an HTTP-header from the server
    inContentTypeIAIMPStringMime type of received content data
    inContentSizeInt64 Content size in bytes. can be equal to zero if content size is undefined.
    varAllowLongBool Set this parameter to FALSE to prevent content downloading and cancel the operation
    OnComplete
    inErrorInfoIAIMPErrorInfo The ErrorInfo parameter contains extended information about the error, if operation failed.
    inCanceledLongBool True if operation was canceled by user
    OnProgress
    inDownloadedInt64 Count of downloaded data in bytes
    inTotalInt64 Total data size in bytes. can be equal to zero, if total data size is undefined.
    Creating the instance
    Instance of interface must be created by plugin and set to one of the IAIMPServiceHTTPClient methods.

    IAIMPImageContainer
    Description
    The IAIMPImageContainer interface unlike IAIMPImage is used for storing and sharing images. The image data is compressed and all requested parameters are calculated on-fly.

    The IAIMPHashCode interface is supported by this object.
    Methods
    CreateImage
    Method creates IAIMPImage that based on copy of source data.
    outImageIAIMPImage
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - The method was successfully completed
    E_INVALIDARG - One of the arguments is not valid
    E_NOTIMPL - The method is not implemented
    E_UNEXPECTED - An unexpected failure occurred
    GetInfo
    Information about the image.
    Information is calculated on-fly using format headers - image data is not uncompressed to do it. Note that this information can be wrong if format headers in the file are corrupted.
    outSizeTSize Size of image
    outFormatIDInteger Format identificator, can be one of the following values:
  • AIMP_IMAGE_FORMAT_UNKNOWN

  • AIMP_IMAGE_FORMAT_PNG

    E_ACCESSDENIED - The method was called from non-main thread
    Creating the instance
    Instance must be created via <IAIMPCore>.CreateObject(IID_IAIMPMenuItem, ...) method during plugin initialization. After creating, plugin should populate all required properties and register the action via <IAIMPCore>.RegisterExtension(IID_IAIMPServiceMenuManager, <IAIMPMenuItem>).

    Removing menu item
    All menu items will be automatically unregistered before plugin finalization. But if you need to remove menu item during program life time - you should use the IAIMPCore.UnregisterExtension method, that unregistering the menu item and it sub items, and resets the AIMP_MENUITEM_PROPID_PARENT property (to nil / null). To reuse the removed menu item, you must re-initialize it and register in the program.

    IAIMPMLAlbumArtProvider2
    Description
    This interface implements image provider for group details and thumbnails in music library that provided via plugin. Unlike IAIMPServiceAlbumArt this provider works with unique data from the music library.

    The interface must be implemented by plugin on same level as the IAIMPMLExtensionDataStorage interface.

    Interface implementation must support asynchronous access.
    Methods
    Get
    inFieldsIAIMPObjectList List of field names presented as IAIMPString that contains a AIMPML_FIELDFLAG_REQUIRED flag in the AIMPML_FIELD_PROPID_FLAGS property value.
    inValuesPVarValue Pointer to first element of the VarValue array. Size of array is same value of the Fields.GetCount method result.
    Contains values for the Fields based on first file in group.
    inRequestIAIMPAlbumArtRequestSearch options, refer to the properties of the IAIMPServiceAlbumArt service topic for more information.

    Attention! You must check the current options before start the search. Extension must return the E_FAIL code if options does not match to the requirements for search.

    Here is a small example that show how to interact with IAIMPAlbumArtRequest. The example downloads the image that defined as URL in corresponding tag field:

    function Get(FileInfo: IAIMPFileInfo; Request: IAIMPAlbumArtRequest; out Image: IAIMPImageContainer): HRESULT; stdcall;
    var
      ALink: IAIMPString;
    begin
      Result := E_FAIL;
      // Is file info has a url?
      if PropListGetStr(FileInfo, AIMP_FILEINFO_PROPID_URL, ALink) then
      begin 
        // Is image url? 
        if IsImageURL(ALink) then 
        begin
          // Is image already cached? 
          if Succeeded(Request.CacheGet(ALink, Image)) then
            Exit(S_OK);
            
          // Download the image
          // The Download function will consider values of the 
          // AIMP_ALBUMART_REQUEST_PROPID_FIND_IN_INTERNET and AIMP_ALBUMART_REQUEST_PROPID_FIND_IN_INTERNET_MAX_FILE_SIZE options
          if Succeeded(Request.Download(ALink, Image)) then
          begin
            // Optimize the image and cache it 
            Request.CachePut(ALink, Image);
            Result := S_OK;
          end;
        end;
      end;
    end;
    outImageIAIMPImageContainer Image for the group
    outResultHRESULT S_OK - if operation successfully completed
    E_FAIL - if error occured or provider has no image for the group
    E_NOTIMPL - provider does not work, player will turn to IAIMPServiceAlbumArt service
    Summary
    Definitions:apiMusicLibrary.pas / apiMusicLibrary.h
    Multi-threading:Supported
    Applications:Player

    IAIMPMLDataStorageManager
    Description
    The interface provides an ability to notify music library about the changes in data storage.
    Instance of interface creates by music library manager and put to plugin via the IAIMPMLExtensionDataStorage.Initialize method.
    Methods
    BackgroundTaskStarted
    The BackgroundTaskStarted / BackgroundTaskFinished methods provides an ability to notify the Music Library manager about running a background tasks that related to the data storage.

    Note 1: the first of background tasks will be displayed to end user (this ability is depended from the skin).
    Note 2: both of functions must be called from main thread.
    inIDInteger Unique ID of background task.
    inCaptionIAIMPString Text that will be displayed to end user.

    You can change the content of this variable during execution of the background task. Note that the changes will be displayed on the screen with small delay.
    inCancelEventIAIMPActionEvent Cancel button handler.
    Put the nil/null to disable an ability to cancel this task.
    BackgroundTaskFinished
    inIDInteger Unique ID of background task
    Changed
    Notifies the manager that data in data storage has been changed. This reloads the data in all views of Music Library and smart-playlists.

    IAIMPMLExtensionDataStorage
    Description
    The extension for the IAIMPServiceMusicLibrary service provides an ability to plugin to implement custom data storage for the Music Library.

    Interface implementation must support asynchronous access.
    Parent
    IAIMPMLExtensionDataStorage inherits from IAIMPPropertyList
    Properties
    Following properties are available for methods of IAIMPPropertyList interface:

    AIMPML_DATASTORAGE_PROPID_ID
    Global unique ID of the data storage
    TypeIAIMPString
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsObject(.., IID_IAIMPString, ..)
    AIMPML_DATASTORAGE_PROPID_CAPTION
    User friendly name of data storage
    TypeIAIMPString
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsObject(.., IID_IAIMPString, ..)
    AIMPML_DATASTORAGE_PROPID_CAPABILITIES
    0 or combination of the following flags:
    • AIMPML_DATASTORAGE_CAP_FILTERING - the storage implements data filtering by itself. Otherwise - data filtering will be processed by Music Library engine
    • AIMPML_DATASTORAGE_CAP_GROUPINGPRESETS - allows to user to create a grouping presets.
    • AIMPML_DATASTORAGE_CAP_PREIMAGES - allows to user to create smart-playlist based on this data storage (this option has no effect to the IAIMPExtensionPlaylistPreimageFactory implementation).

    • AIMPML_DATASTORAGE_CAP_CUSTOMIZEGROUPS - allows to user customize list of fields that used for grouping and group details.
    • AIMPML_DATASTORAGE_CAP_NOBOOKMARKS - switching off saving / restoring of grouping tree selection. May be useful if restoring the selection takes too much time.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    Methods
    Initialize
    Method calls after succeeded registration of data storage.
    inManagerIAIMPMLDataStorageManager The Manager interface is used to notify the Music Library about the changes in data storage.
    Finalize
    Method calls before the finalization of plugin. Plugin must release all external links.
    FlushCache
    Method calls when user executes the "refresh" command via hotkey or context menu. After this call the Music Library engine will automatically reload the data from data storage.
    inReservedIntegerReserved, must be set to 0
    ConfigLoad
    Warning: method will be called on first activation of tab of data storage in Music Library interface
    inConfigIAIMPConfig
    inSectionIAIMPString Section Name to that contains the settings.
    You can use the children section names if it needed: Section + "." + ChildSectionName
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - If success, any other value otherwise
    ConfigSave
    inConfigIAIMPConfig
    inSectionIAIMPString Section Name to store the settings.
    You can use the children section names if it needed: Section + "." + ChildSectionName
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - If success, any other value otherwise
    GetFields
    Method returns settings and layout of the data fields in dependency from specified Schema value.
    inSchemaInteger One of the following values:
    • AIMPML_FIELDS_SCHEMA_ALL - list of all available fields in data storage. List must contains an IAIMPMLDataField objects
    • AIMPML_FIELDS_SCHEMA_TABLE_GROUPBY - list of fields that used for grouping in table. If list is empty - the Group Details and the Album Thumbnails views will not be available for the end user. List of IAIMPString that contains a field names only
    • AIMPML_FIELDS_SCHEMA_TABLE_GROUPDETAILS - list of fields that displays in group details area. List of IAIMPString that contains a field names only
    • AIMPML_FIELDS_SCHEMA_TABLE_VIEW_DEFAULT - list of fields that displays to end user in table by default in Default view. List of IAIMPString that contains a field names only
    • AIMPML_FIELDS_SCHEMA_TABLE_VIEW_GROUPDETAILS - list of fields that displays to end user in table by default in Group Details view. List of IAIMPString that contains a field names only
    • AIMPML_FIELDS_SCHEMA_TABLE_VIEW_ALBUMTHUMBNAILS - list of fields that displays to end user in table by default in Album Thumbnails view. List of IAIMPString that contains a field names only

    Warning!
    Data storage MUST contains a fields with following names:
    • AIMPML_RESERVED_FIELD_ID - unique ID of record in data storage
    • AIMPML_RESERVED_FIELD_FILENAME - file name of the record that used by player
    If this fields are not defined in Data Storage - registration of the extension will be failed.


    Also, the Music Library engine provides an ability to use following special fields:
    • AIMPML_RESERVED_FIELD_FILESIZE - file size in bytes (type: Int64), used to calculate information about the content of table
    • AIMPML_RESERVED_FIELD_DURATION - duration in seconds (type: Double) ,used to calculate information about the content of table
    • AIMPML_RESERVED_FIELD_USERMARK - user rating mark (type: Double), Refer to the IAIMPMLDataStorageCommandUserMark
    outListIAIMPObjectList List of the IAIMPMLDataField or IAIMPString in dependency from specified Schema.
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - If success, any other value otherwise
    GetGroupingPresets
    Plugin must populate the Presets list by predefined presets for grouping tree based on the Schema value.
    inSchemaInteger One of the following values:
    • AIMPML_GROUPINGPRESETS_SCHEMA_BUILTIN - built-in presets (cannot be deleted or edited by user)
    • AIMPML_GROUPINGPRESETS_SCHEMA_DEFAULT - predefined user presets (can be removed or customized by user)

    Warning!
    Plugin must add least one built-in preset.
    inPresetsIAIMPMLGroupingPresets
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - If success, any other value otherwise
    Creating instance
    Instance should be created by plugin and must be registered in the application in the plugin initialization method via the IAIMPCore.RegisterExtension method.

    IAIMPOptionsDialogFrame
    Description
    Interface provides an information about custom sheet for Options Dialog.
    Methods
    GetName
    outSIAIMPString Displaying name, can be depended from current localization.
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - If success, any other value otherwise
    CreateFrame
    inParentWindowHWND Handle of parent window, where frame must be placed.
    The frame will be automatically aligned to entire client area of the parent window.
    In Linux, window handles are emulated by GUI API, they are not compatible with handles from 3rd-party apps or libraries.
    outResultHWND Handle of custom sheet window.
    In Linux, window handles are emulated by GUI API, they are not compatible with handles from 3rd-party apps or libraries.
    DestroyFrame
    Notification
    inIDInteger Notification ID, can be one of following values:
    • AIMP_SERVICE_OPTIONSDIALOG_NOTIFICATION_LOAD - custom sheet should initialize all settings with values from configuration file
    • AIMP_SERVICE_OPTIONSDIALOG_NOTIFICATION_LOCALIZATION - localization has been changed, custom sheet should update localization of embedded controls
    • AIMP_SERVICE_OPTIONSDIALOG_NOTIFICATION_SAVE - custom sheet should save all settings to configuration file
    • AIMP_SERVICE_OPTIONSDIALOG_NOTIFICATION_CAN_SAVE - notification occurs before saving to an ability to validate settings. If one of settings is not valid - plugin should raise the exception. Note that text of exception will not shown to user.
    • AIMP_SERVICE_OPTIONSDIALOG_NOTIFICATION_RESET - custom sheet should reset all settings to it defaults
    DPI Aware
    The WM_DPICHANGED sent to frame handle (refer to the CreateFrame method) when scale factor for the Options Dialog has changed. Plugin must handle this message and scale content of the frame.
    Creating instance
    Instance should be created by plugin and must be registered in the application in the plugin initialization method via the IAIMPCore.RegisterExtension method.
    Example
    Example is located on the Demos \ OptionFrameDemo

    inObjectIAIMPStringIAIMPString with FileURI or IAIMPFileInfo (if AIMP_PLAYLIST_ADD_FLAGS_FILEINFO flag is presents)
    inFlagsDWORD Zero or combination of followed flags:
  • AIMP_PLAYLIST_ADD_FLAGS_NOCHECKFORMAT - flag suppresses file format checking
  • AIMP_PLAYLIST_ADD_FLAGS_NOEXPAND - flag suppresses file expansion to few virtual files
  • AIMP_PLAYLIST_ADD_FLAGS_NOASYNC - file adding will be processed in main thread, the method will not return control until operation has been completed (not recommended)

    IAIMPPlaylistListener
    Description
    Interface provides an ability to receive notifications about changes in the playlist
    Methods
    Activated
    Event occurs when playlist is activating
    Changed
    inFlagsDWORD Combination of following flags:
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_NAME - the playlist name has been changed
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_GROUPNAME - the playlist has been moved to another group (v5.40)
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_SELECTION - the list of selected entries has been changed
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_MODIFIED - the playlist has been changed, the file needs to be resaved
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_DEADSTATE - one or more files in the playlist were marked as “not found”
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_MAKEVISIBLE - the user requested that the playable file be made visible
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_PLAYBACKQUEUE - the playlist playback order has been changed
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_PLAYBACKCURSOR - changed playback cursor
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_PLAYBACKBOOKMARK - the timestamp has been changed of the playback cursor (v5.40)
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_FOCUSINDEX - the focus has moved to another entry
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_CONTENT - the order of entries and/or groups in the playlist has been changed
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_FILEINFO - information in one or more entries has been changed
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_STATISTICS - playlist statistics have changed (number of files, duration, size)
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_PLAYINGSWITCHES - the state of the autoplay switches for one or more entries has been changed
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_READONLY - the "read only" status has been changed
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_PREIMAGE - the path to the preimage has been changed
    • AIMP_PLAYLIST_NOTIFY_SETTINGS - the displaying/grouping settings has been changed (v6.00)
    Removed
    Event occurs before deleting / unloading

    IAIMPPlaylistPreimage
    Description
    The IAIMPPlaylistPreimage interface is a general interface for all preimages.

    Preimage is data source for smart-playlists with manual or automatic synchronization. The principle of cooperation between preimage and playlist is so simple: when data or settings in preimage are changed - preimage notify playlist about the changes via the IAIMPPlaylistPreimageListener interface that related to binded playlist. Playlist, in own case, will reload data from preimage as soon as data will be required by plugin or user.
    Parent
    IAIMPPlaylistPreimage inherits from IAIMPPropertyList
    Properties
    Following properties are available for methods of IAIMPPropertyList interface:

    AIMP_PLAYLISTPREIMAGE_PROPID_FACTORYID
    ID of factory that creates this preimage
    TypeIAIMPString
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsObject(.., IID_IAIMPString, ..)
    AIMP_PLAYLISTPREIMAGE_PROPID_AUTOSYNC
    The Value different from 0 if automatic synchronization is switched on in the preimage (note that not all preimages support for this property).
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMP_PLAYLISTPREIMAGE_PROPID_AUTOSYNC_ON_STARTUP
    The Value different from 0 if automatic synchronization is switched on in the preimage at Application startup (note that not all preimages support for this property).
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMP_PLAYLISTPREIMAGE_PROPID_HASDIALOG
    Return value different from 0 if preimage has implementation of the ExecuteDialog method.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    AIMP_PLAYLISTPREIMAGE_PROPID_SORTTEMPLATE
    Return sorting template for values in playlist after adding files from preimage
    TypeIAIMPString
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsObject(ID, IID_IAIMPString, ..)
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsObject(ID, <IAIMPString>)

    IAIMPPlugin
    Methods
    InfoGet
    Method returns an information about the plugin.
    Method must not require the plugin initialization.
    inIndexInteger One of the values:
    • AIMP_PLUGIN_INFO_NAME
    • AIMP_PLUGIN_INFO_AUTHOR
    • AIMP_PLUGIN_INFO_SHORT_DESCRIPTION
    • AIMP_PLUGIN_INFO_FULL_DESCRIPTION
    outResultPChar Pointer to an char null-terminated array. Can be nil/null.
    InfoGetCategories
    Method returns an information about plugin categories.
    This information is used by Plugins Manager only for grouping purposes in the list of plugins
    Method must not require the plugin initialization.
    outResultDWORD One or combination of following flags:
    • AIMP_PLUGIN_CATEGORY_ADDONS
    • AIMP_PLUGIN_CATEGORY_DECODERS
    • AIMP_PLUGIN_CATEGORY_VISUALS
    • AIMP_PLUGIN_CATEGORY_DSP
    Initialize
    inCoreIAIMPCore Reference to the basic interface
    outResultHRESULT S_OK - if success, other value otherwise.

    Note that plugin can be loaded by Audio Converter or Tag Editor tool. You should check on plugin initialization if all required built-in services are available. If some services are not available plugin may return an error code - AIMP will mark this plugin as unused.

    At this moment, the "current folder" of the OS refers to the plugin folder. You can use the "current folder" to determine where exactly your plugin is placed.

    Refer to the "Guidelines for working with services"
    Finalize
    This method will be called before unload the plugin library.
    Note that method will not be called if the Initialize method return value different from S_OK.
    SystemNotification
    Handler of system notifications
    Refer to the "Guidelines for working with services"
    inNotifyIDInteger Notification ID.
    Can be one of following values:
    • AIMP_SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION_SERVICE_ADDED
    • AIMP_SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION_SERVICE_REMOVED
    • AIMP_SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION_EXTENSION_REMOVED
    inDataIUnknown Changing object. Can be nil / null;
    Remark
    If plugin has external settings dialog, it should implement the IAIMPExternalSettingsDialog interface on same to IAIMPPlugin interface level.
    Creating the instance
    The instance of interface must be created by plugin during call of exported AIMPPluginGetHeader function.

    function AIMPPluginGetHeader(out Header: IAIMPPlugin): HRESULT; stdcall;
    Interface definition
    Interface definition is located in the apiPlugin.pas / apiPlugin.h

    Name conversion
    Name template
    Name of property ID is based on specific rule and contains additional information: type of object and description

    Name template looks like:
      AIMP_OOOOO_PROPID_DDDDD
    Where:
      OOOOO - type of parent object (without "IAIMP" prefix)
      DDDDD - description

    Example 1:
      AIMP_FILEINFO_PROPID_ALBUMGAIN

      Description: AlbumGain
      Object type: FILEINFO - IAIMPFileInfo

    Example 2:
      AIMP_FILEINFO_PROPID_ALBUMARTIST

      Description: AlbumArtist
      Object type: FILEINFO - IAIMPFileInfo

    Custom properties
    Value of custom properties identifications must be started from value defined in the AIMP_PROPERTYLIST_CUSTOM_PROPID_BASE constant to prevent conflicts in future versions of SDK.
    © Artem Izmaylov, 2006-2026
    Free Audio Player

    IAIMPServiceFileSystems
    Description
    The IAIMPServiceFileSystems service provides an access to commands for specified FileURI.
    General principle
    File system is a set of interfaces that provides an ability to operate with files with special file path:
    scheme://path or scheme:\\path
    Each extension of service presents single scheme. Before operate with file, AIMP search the file system for specified FileURI. If no extension of this file system was found - AIMP will use the interface of default file system..
    Methods
    Get
    Provides an ability to get interface instance of command by IID for specified scheme. Scheme detects by FileURI.
    inFileURIIAIMPStringVirtual FileURI
    inIIDTGUID IID of command interface

    Methods
    ProcessEnvironmentVariables
    Processes environment variables in specified uri.

    Environment variable must be defined using following template: %env_var_name%
    Example: %AIMPBIN%\AIMP.exe

    Additionally to system variables, AIMP provides few built-in:
  • AIMP_SERVICE_FILEURI_ENVAR_APPDATA - %AppData% - path to application data directory
  • AIMP_SERVICE_FILEURI_ENVAR_DESKTOP - %Desktop% - path to user desktop
  • AIMP_SERVICE_FILEURI_ENVAR_HOME - %Home% - path to user home directory
  • AIMP_SERVICE_FILEURI_ENVAR_MYDOCUMENTS - %MyDocuments% - path to "My Documents" directory
  • AIMP_SERVICE_FILEURI_ENVAR_MYMUSIC - %MyMusic% - path to "My Music" directory
  • AIMP_SERVICE_FILEURI_ENVAR_PROFILE - %Profile% - path to AIMP profile folder
  • AIMP_SERVICE_FILEURI_ENVAR_TEMP - %Temp% - path to temporary directory
    • varFileURIIAIMPString
    inFlagsDWORD One of flags:
  • AIMP_SERVICE_FILEURI_ENVAR_FLAG_EXPAND - replaces the variables by their actual values
  • AIMP_SERVICE_FILEURI_ENVAR_FLAG_COLLAPSE - replaces the values by variable names (for built-in variables only)

    IAIMPServiceHTTPClient
    Description
    This service provides an ability to send "GET" or "POST" queries to remote HTTP servers.

    All queries are running in separate threads - you should not create thread by yourself.
    Plugin will be notified via IAIMPHTTPClientEvents when query will be completed
    Methods
    Get
    inURLIAIMPStringTo create a secure connection, you must specify "https://" in the URL.

    AIMP provides an ability to put custom fields in the HTTP-header. You should specify it in the URL string separate each field by CRLF.

    Example:
    'https://example.org/'#13#10'Field 1: Data'#13#10'Field 2: Data'
    inFlagsDWORDZero or combination of followed flags:
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_WAITFOR - the method will not return control until operation has been completed. Not recommended
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_ASYNC_ACCEPT - IAIMPHTTPClientEvents.OnAccept event will be called without synchronization (from non main thread) (Since v6)
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_ASYNC_COMPLETE - IAIMPHTTPClientEvents.OnComplete event will be called without synchronization (from non main thread) (Since v6)
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_ASYNC_PROGRESS - IAIMPHTTPClientEvents.OnProgress event will be called without synchronization (from non main thread) (Since v6)
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_IGNORE_CERT_ISSUES - do not interrupt the connection if there are any issues with the certificate or if there is no connection to the certification authority (Since v6)
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_PRIORITY_XXX - task priority, refer to the IAIMPTaskPriority
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_UTF8 - Use this flag to encode URL value to the UTF-8 Encoding
    • inAnswerDataIAIMPStream Instance of binary stream for response from the server.
    inEventsHandlerIAIMPHTTPClientEvents See also IAIMPHTTPClientEvents2
    inParamsIAIMPConfig Extended settings for query (Optional, can be nil / null).
    For now you can use following parameters:
    • "File\Offset" - initial position in bytes (Int64). If server does not support seeking, query will be completed with error
    outTaskTTaskHandle Unique ID of asynchronous task
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - The method was successfully completed
    E_INVALIDARG - One of the arguments is not valid
    E_NOTIMPL - The method is not implemented
    E_UNEXPECTED - An unexpected failure occurred
    Post
    inURLIAIMPStringTo create a secure connection, you must specify "https://" in the URL.

    AIMP provides an ability to put custom fields in the HTTP-header. You should specify it in the URL string separate each field by CRLF.

    Example:
    'https://example.org/'#13#10'Field 1: Data'#13#10'Field 2: Data'
    inFlagsDWORDZero or combination of followed flags:
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_WAITFOR - the method will not return control until operation has been completed. Not recommended
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_ASYNC_ACCEPT - IAIMPHTTPClientEvents.OnAccept event will be called without synchronization (from non main thread) (Since v6)
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_ASYNC_COMPLETE - IAIMPHTTPClientEvents.OnComplete event will be called without synchronization (from non main thread) (Since v6)
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_ASYNC_PROGRESS - IAIMPHTTPClientEvents.OnProgress event will be called without synchronization (from non main thread) (Since v6)
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_IGNORE_CERT_ISSUES - do not interrupt the connection if there are any issues with the certificate or if there is no connection to the certification authority (Since v6)
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_PRIORITY_XXX - task priority, refer to the IAIMPTaskPriority
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_UTF8 - Use this flag to encode URL value to the UTF-8 Encoding
    • inAnswerDataIAIMPStream Instance of binary stream for response from the server.
    inPostDataIAIMPStream Data to be sent to the server, can be set to nil / null.
    inEventsHandlerIAIMPHTTPClientEvents
    inParamsIAIMPConfig Reserved, must be set to nil / null
    outTaskTTaskHandle Unique ID of asynchronous task

    outResultHRESULTS_OK - The method was successfully completed
    E_INVALIDARG - One of the arguments is not valid
    E_NOTIMPL - The method is not implemented
    E_UNEXPECTED - An unexpected failure occurred
    Cancel
    Method allow you to cancel active task
    inTaskTTaskHandle Unique ID of asynchronous task

    inFlagsDWORDZero or combination of followed flags:
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_WAITFOR - the method will not return control until operation has been completed. Not recommended
    • outResultHRESULTS_OK - The method was successfully completed
    E_INVALIDARG - One of the arguments is not valid
    E_NOTIMPL - The method is not implemented
    E_UNEXPECTED - An unexpected failure occurred
    Access to service
    <IAIMPCore>.QueryInterface(IID_IAIMPServiceHTTPClient, ...);

    Description

    Methods
    Request
    inURLIAIMPStringTo create a secure connection, you must specify "https://" in the URL.

    AIMP provides an ability to put custom fields in the HTTP-header. You should specify it in the URL string separate each field by CRLF.

    Example:
    'https://example.org/'#13#10'Field 1: Data'#13#10'Field 2: Data'
    inMethodDWORD Request method, can be one of following values:
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_METHOD_GET
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_METHOD_POST
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_METHOD_PUT
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_METHOD_DELETE
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_METHOD_HEAD

  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_WAITFOR - the method will not return control until operation has been completed. Not recommended
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_ASYNC_ACCEPT - IAIMPHTTPClientEvents.OnAccept event will be called without synchronization (from non main thread) (Since v6)
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_ASYNC_COMPLETE - IAIMPHTTPClientEvents.OnComplete event will be called without synchronization (from non main thread) (Since v6)
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_ASYNC_PROGRESS - IAIMPHTTPClientEvents.OnProgress event will be called without synchronization (from non main thread) (Since v6)
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_IGNORE_CERT_ISSUES - do not interrupt the connection if there are any issues with the certificate or if there is no connection to the certification authority (Since v6)
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_PRIORITY_XXX - task priority, refer to the IAIMPTaskPriority
  • AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_FLAGS_UTF8 - Use this flag to encode URL value to the UTF-8 Encoding
    • inAnswerDataIAIMPStream Instance of binary stream for response from the server.
    inPostDataIAIMPStream Data to be sent to the server, can be set to nil / null.

    Only for Method = AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_METHOD_POST / AIMP_SERVICE_HTTPCLIENT_METHOD_PUT.

    IAIMPServicePlayer
    Description
    This service provides an access to playback control interface.
    Properties
    Following properties are available for methods of IAIMPPropertyList interface:
    An access to the IAIMPPropertyList interface is provided by <IAIMPServicePlayer>.QueryInterface(IID_IAIMPPropertyList, ..);
    AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_ACTION_ON_END_OF_TRACK
    0 - Default
    1 - Jump to next track and stop playback
    2 - Jump to next track and suspend playback

    See also: AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_AUTOSWITCHING.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_AUTO_JUMP_TO_NEXT_TRACK
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_AUTOSWITCHING
    Provides an ability to switch off all effects when switching between tracks automatically.
    0 - switched off.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_AUTOSWITCHING_PAUSE_BETWEEN_TRACKS
    In milliseconds. 0 - switched off.
    See also: AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_AUTOSWITCHING.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_AUTOSWITCHING_CROSSFADE
    Time of cross fade effect when switching between tracks automatically, In milliseconds. 0 - switched off.
    See also: AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_AUTOSWITCHING.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_AUTOSWITCHING_FADEIN
    Time of volume fade in effect at beginning of track when switching between tracks automatically, in milliseconds. 0 - switched off.
    See also: AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_AUTOSWITCHING.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_AUTOSWITCHING_FADEOUT
    Time of volume fade out effect at ending of track when switching between tracks automatically, in milliseconds. 0 - switched off.
    See also: AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_AUTOSWITCHING.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_MANUALSWITCHING
    Provides an ability to switch off all effects when switching between tracks manually.
    0 - switched off.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_MANUALSWITCHING_CROSSFADE
    Time of cross fade effect when switching between tracks manually, In milliseconds. 0 - switched off.
    See also: AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_MANUALSWITCHING.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_MANUALSWITCHING_FADEIN

    See also: AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_MANUALSWITCHING.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_MANUALSWITCHING_FADEOUT

    See also: AIMP_PLAYER_PROPID_MANUALSWITCHING.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32

    Determines sound output parameters.
    To fetch/change current device, use the IAIMPString as argument.
    To fetch list of available devices, query the IAIMPObjectList.
    TypeIAIMPString / IAIMPObjectList

    Methods
    Play
    inItemIAIMPPlaybackQueueItemNote 1: Note that function doesn't check if file playback really started. It just put the file into queue of loading thread (Refer to the AIMP_MSG_EVENT_STREAM_START).
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - The method was successfully completed

    Play2
    inItemIAIMPPlaylistItemNote 1: Note that function doesn't check if file playback really started. It just put the file into queue of loading thread (Refer to the AIMP_MSG_EVENT_STREAM_START).
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - The method was successfully completed

    Play3
    inPlaylistIAIMPPlaylistNote 1: Note that function doesn't check if file playback really started. It just put the file into queue of loading thread (Refer to the AIMP_MSG_EVENT_STREAM_START).
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - The method was successfully completed
    E_INVALIDARG - One of the arguments is not valid
    E_NOTIMPL - The method is not implemented
    E_UNEXPECTED - An unexpected failure occurred
    Play4
    inFileURIIAIMPStringFileURI (can be file path to playlist)
    inFlagsDWORD Combination of following flags:
    • AIMP_SERVICE_PLAYER_FLAGS_PLAY_FROM_PLAYLIST - player will search file with this file name in all loaded playlists, if succeeded - will start play it.
    • AIMP_SERVICE_PLAYER_FLAGS_PLAY_FROM_PLAYLIST_CAN_ADD - this flag should be used with previous one, if file is not found in loaded playlists - it will be added to playlist (target playlist is chosen based on current settings)
    • AIMP_SERVICE_PLAYER_FLAGS_PLAY_WITHOUT_ADDING_TO_PLAYLIST - start file playback without adding it to playlist
    • AIMP_SERVICE_PLAYER_FLAGS_PLAY_SUSPENDED - pause playback on track beginning
    Note 1: Note that function doesn't check if file playback really started. It just put the file into queue of loading thread (Refer to the AIMP_MSG_EVENT_STREAM_START).

    Note 2: the method returns E_FAIL if file does not correspond to conditions that specified via flags.

    Note 3: if FileURI contains path to the playlist file, the AIMP_SERVICE_PLAYER_FLAGS_PLAY_WITHOUT_ADDING_TO_PLAYLIST flag ignored, because player cannot start playlist playback without importing it.
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - The method was successfully completed
    E_INVALIDARG - One of the arguments is not valid
    E_NOTIMPL - The method is not implemented
    E_UNEXPECTED - An unexpected failure occurred

    Description
    IAIMPServiceShutdown provides an ability to shutdown Windows or the application.

    Shutdown
    inFlagsDWORD Combination of following flags:
    • AIMP_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_FLAGS_HIBERNATE
    • AIMP_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_FLAGS_POWEROFF
    • AIMP_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_FLAGS_SLEEP
    • AIMP_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_FLAGS_LOGOFF
    • AIMP_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_FLAGS_REBOOT
    • AIMP_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_FLAGS_CLOSE_APP
    • AIMP_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_FLAGS_NO_CONFIRM - Suppress confirmation dialog (for Computer shutdown only)

    Remark 1: flags AIMP_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_FLAGS_HIBERNATE, AIMP_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_FLAGS_SHUTDOWN, AIMP_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_FLAGS_LOGOFF, AIMP_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_FLAGS_REBOOT and AIMP_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_FLAGS_SLEEP must not be used at same time.

    Remark 2: flag AIMP_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_FLAGS_CLOSE_APP can be used only with AIMP_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_FLAGS_SLEEP or AIMP_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_FLAGS_HIBERNATE.

    IAIMPServiceThreads
    Description
    Service provides an access to thread pool and allows to plugin add a task to asynchronous execution. Note that number of running threads at same time is limited. All tasks will be added to special queue and will be executed when one of the threads is idle.

    Warning! Make sure that all your tasks is completed or canceled during plugin finalization.
    Methods
    ExecuteInMainThread
    inTaskIAIMPTask
    inFlagsDWORD Zero or combination of following flags:
  • AIMP_SERVICE_THREADS_FLAGS_WAITFOR - the method will not return control until operation has been completed if this flag is used. Not recommended. Otherwise, task will be queued and executed when main thread is idle
    • outResultHRESULTS_OK - The method was successfully completed
    E_INVALIDARG - One of the arguments is not valid
    E_NOTIMPL - The method is not implemented

    IAIMPServiceUI
    Description
    GUI is API for creating an UI in style of standard for AIMP controls.

    Service provides an access to common methods for creating windows, controls and objects.
    Methods
    CreateForm
    Method provides an ability to create child or top-level form. Form is a owner for all other controls and objects.
    inOwnerWindowHWND Handle of Owner Window. The form will be placed over the Owner.
    In Linux, window handles are emulated by GUI API, they are not compatible with handles from 3rd-party apps or libraries.
    inFlagsDWORD One of the flags:
  • AIMPUI_SERVICE_CREATEFORM_FLAGS_REGULAR
    Creates a regular window


  • AIMPUI_SERVICE_CREATEFORM_FLAGS_CHILD
    Creates window that will behave as a child control of the owner window


  • AIMPUI_SERVICE_CREATEFORM_FLAGS_LAYERED
    Creates window with per-pixel semi-transparency support. This window cannot be used to place other controls, and all rendering is performed manually using IAIMPUIDrawEvents
    • . To allow the user to resize the window using the mouse, set the AIMPUI_FORM_PROPID_BORDERSTYLE property to AIMPUI_FLAGS_BORDERSTYLE_SIZEABLE and specify AIMPUI_FORM_PROPID_PADDING.
    inNameIAIMPStringName of control, can contains latin symbols and numbers only. Used for automatic localization.
    inEventsHandlerIUnknown Events handler, should be implemented on plugin side. Can be set to nil / null.
    outFormIAIMPUIForm
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - The method was successfully completed
    E_INVALIDARG - One of the arguments is not valid
    E_NOTIMPL - The method is not implemented
    E_UNEXPECTED - An unexpected failure occurred
    E_ACCESSDENIED - The method was called from non-main thread
    CreateControl
    Method creates a control.
    inOwnerIAIMPUIForm All children controls and objects will be destroyed automatically when owner will be destroyed
    inParentIAIMPUIWinControl Parent for the control. Parent must be owned by same form.
    inNameIAIMPStringName of control, can contains latin symbols and numbers only. Used for automatic localization.
    inIIDTGUID IID of the control
    inEventsHandlerIUnknown Events handler, should be implemented on plugin side. Can be set to nil / null.
    outControl Interface for newly created control
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - The method was successfully completed
    E_INVALIDARG - One of the arguments is not valid
    E_NOTIMPL - The method is not implemented
    E_UNEXPECTED - An unexpected failure occurred
    E_ACCESSDENIED - The method was called from non-main thread
    CreateObject
    Methods creates non-visual object with optional bind to a specified window.
    inOwnerIAIMPUIForm All children controls and objects will be destroyed automatically when owner will be destroyed
    Put nil / null if you not need to bind the object to a window. In this case, object will be destroyed as soon as all references to it will be released.

    IAIMPServiceVersionInfo
    Description
    This service provides an access to information about application version.
    Methods
    FormatInfo
    Method returns information about version in following format: 
    v<major number>.<minor number> <build state>, build <build number> (<build date)
    For example:
    v3.60, build 1400 (18.12.2013)
    v3.60 Beta, build 1400 (18.12.2013)
    outSIAIMPStringResult
    outResultHRESULT S_OK - Method successes
    E_UNEXPECTED - Unexpected failure
    GetBuildDate
    outResultInteger Build date.
    HiWord(Result) - year
    HiByte(LoWord(Result)) - month
    LoByte(LoWord(Result)) - day
    GetBuildState
    outResultInteger One of the following values:
    • AIMP_SERVICE_VERSION_STATE_RELEASE
    • AIMP_SERVICE_VERSION_STATE_RELEASE_CANDIDATE
    • AIMP_SERVICE_VERSION_STATE_BETA
    • AIMP_SERVICE_VERSION_STATE_ALPHA
    Note: flags are placed in descending order of product readiness.
    GetBuildNumber
    outResultInteger Absolute build number (not depended from version).
    GetVersionID
    outResultIntegerID of version in the XYYZ format.
    X - Major version number, does not limited
    YY - Minor version number, from 0 to 99
    Z - Number of edition, from 0 to 9

    Examples:
    3551 — 3.55.1
    10051 — 10.05.1
    0010 — 0.01.0

    Access to service
    <IAIMPCore>.QueryInterface(IID_IAIMPServiceVersionInfo, ...);

    IAIMPStream
    Description
    IAIMPStream provides interface for working with binary stream.
    Methods
    GetSize
    outResultInt64Size of stream, in bytes
    SetSize
    Method provides an ability to set stream size, in bytes.

    Note: size of stream will be automatically extended when it needed. This method is for optimization purposes only.

    Warning! If current stream size more than new defined - part of data will be truncated.
    inValueInt64New size, in bytes
    outResultHRESULT S_OK - Method success
    E_NOTIMPL - Stream is read only
    E_UNEXPECTED - Unexpected failure
    GetPosition
    outResultInt64Position of reading / writing cursor in bytes
    Seek
    Method allows you to change position of reading / writing cursor.
    inOffsetInt64Offset in bytes
    inModeInteger The parameter defines as the Offset parameter should be used.
    Can be one of the following values:
    • AIMP_STREAM_SEEKMODE_FROM_BEGINNING - Offset value is offset from stream beginning
    • AIMP_STREAM_SEEKMODE_FROM_CURRENT - Offset value is offset from current cursor position
    • AIMP_STREAM_SEEKMODE_FROM_END - Offset value is offset from the end of stream
    outResultHRESULT S_OK - Method success
    E_FAIL - Can not change the position at specified Offset.
    E_INVALIDARG - One of parameters is invalid
    E_UNEXPECTED - Unexpected failure
    Read
    varBufferPByte
    inCountDWORD
    outResultInteger-1 on unexpected failure or count of read bytes otherwise.
    Write
    inBufferPByte
    inCountDWORD
    outWrittenPInteger Pointer to 32-bit integer value.
    Parameter displays what bytes has been really written to the stream.
    This parameter is optional - can be nil / NULL.
    outResultHRESULT S_OK - Method success
    E_NOTIMPL - Stream is read only
    E_UNEXPECTED - An unexpected failure occurs

    Strings has differences in implementation between Windows and Linux.

    IAIMPTask
    Description
    Must be implemented on plugin level.

    Interface implementation must support asynchronous access.
    Methods
    Execute
    inOwnerIAIMPTaskOwner Owner provides an ability to know if user cancel the task.
    You must abort current operation as soon as possible.
    Recommendations
    During implementation the Execute method handler you should call the IsCanceled method and check it result. If method returns True - you must abort current operation as soon as possible.

    Example:
    procedure <IAIMPTask>.Execute(Owner: IAIMPTaskOwner);
    begin
      // Check if task is canceled
      if Owner.IsCanceled then 
        // aborting the operation  
      
      // do something
       
      // Check if task is canceled
      if Owner.IsCanceled then 
        // aborting the operation
          
      // do something
    end;

    IAIMPUIAuthDialog
    Descriptions
    IAIMPUIAuthDialog simplifies the OAuth2 (and like that) authorization process.

    OAuth2-authorization assumes that the user will log in to the service in the browser, and the browser will already pass the authorization token to the application via the url callback. While the dialog is displayed, AIMP starts a local server at localhost:8090 and waits for callback from the service, which will be passed to the plugin via IAIMPUIAuthDialogEvents.

    The user can cancel the authorization process by simply closing the dialog box. In this case, the Execute function will end with the E_FAIL code.
    Methods
    Execute
    inOwnerWndHWND Handle of owner window.
    Set this variable to 0 to use handle of main window of the application.
    In Linux, window handles are emulated by GUI API, they are not compatible with handles from 3rd-party apps or libraries.
    inTitleIAIMPString Service title for which the dialog was called. Shown to user in the dialog.
    inTextIAIMPString Authorization hints.
    Push the nil/null to use default authorization hints.
    inEventsHandlerIAIMPUIAuthDialogEvents
    inFlagsDWORD 0, reserved for future usage
    outResultHRESULTS_OK - The method was successfully completed
    E_INVALIDARG - One of the arguments is not valid
    E_NOTIMPL - The method is not implemented
    E_UNEXPECTED - An unexpected failure occurred
    E_ACCESSDENIED - The method was called from non-main thread
    Access to Interface
    <IAIMPServiceUI>.QueryInterface(IID_IAIMPUIAuthDialog, <IAIMPUIAuthDialog>)

    Automatic Localization
    Overview
    Engine of AIMP can localize all forms and controls automatically. If you want to use this feature of engine, you must setup your own localization file with following rules. And do not forget to set names for all forms and controls.
    Rules
    1. Section name in localization file must be equals to name of IAIMPUIForm.


    2. Key name must be equals to name of IAIMPUIControl, in this case the value of key will be applied to caption of the control.


    3. To localize tool tip for control, create the key with name of control with ".h" suffix.

    [Form Name]
    MyButton.h=Hint for the button
    4. Separate section is used to localize list of Combobox controls that obeys to following rule: 

    [Form Name.Control Name]
    i[0]=Item 1
    i[1]=Item 2
    5. Separate section is used to localize in-place buttons of IAIMPUIBaseButtonnedEdit descendants that obeys to following rule: 

    [Form Name.Control Name]
    b[0]=Button 1
    b[1]=Button 2
    6. Same rule is used for columns of IAIMPUITreeList: 

    [Form Name.Control Name]
    c[0]=Column 1
    c[1]=Column 2
    7. Separate section is used to localize the TextHint of IAIMPUIEdit that contains a "th" key: 

    [Form Name.Control Name]
    th=hint for the editor
    8. Separate global section is used to localize menu items and actions. Instead of name the ID field is used:

    [Common]
    <Action.ID>=Action 1
    <Action.ID>.h=Hint for Action 1
    <Action.ID>.g=Group name 1
    <MenuItem.ID>=Menu Item 2
    Since AIMP6, the Caption, GroupName and Hint properties can refers to built-in localizations, just set the value in following format:
    @Section\Key
    © Artem Izmaylov, 2006-2026
