    www.aimp.ru
    Color accent support
    Description
    Starting from AIMP 5, user able to change color accent of entire application (including all secondary windows). Color accent of elements based on GUI API changes automatically.
    But, if your plugin uses custom draw or custom elements you need to use the IAIMPUIColorSchema interface to implement color accent support. IAIMPUIColorSchema implemented on the IAIMPServiceUI level.
    IAIMPUIColorSchema Methods
    ApplyToARGB
    varARGBDWORD Applies color schema to color in ARGB format (the TAlphaColor type in Delphi terms).
    ApplyToColor
    varColorDWORD Applies color schema to color in BGR format (the TColor type in Delphi terms).
    ApplyToColors
    varColorsPRGBQuad Applies color schema to array of RGBQuad.
    inNumberOfColorsInteger number of colors in the array
    ApplyToImage
    varImageIAIMPImage Applies color schema to specified image.

    Creating the instance
    You can take a reference to the interface via <IAIMPServiceUI>.QueryInterface.

    Notifications
    On change the color accent, GUI framework will broadcast the AIMP_MSG_EVENT_UI_MODE message and call the IAIMPUIFormEvents3.OnStyleChanged event.

    See Also
  • Hook broadcast messages
  • IAIMPUIMode

    DPI Awareness
    Description
    GUI-framework is already adapted for support of 100%-200% scale factors.

    Coordinates Translation
    By default, GUI framework uses 96 dpi (independent from real scale factor) to define positions and sizes of controls - coordinates translation mode. Plugin can switch off the coordinates translation mode via the IAIMPUIDPIAwareness interface that implemented on the IAIMPUIForm side.

    The IAIMPUIDPIAwareness methods
    IAIMPUIDPIAwareness.IsDPIAware
    outResultBOOL True - means that plugin is dpi aware, coordinates translation mode is switched off.
    IAIMPUIDPIAwareness.SetDPIAware
    Method provides an ability to switch off / on the coordinates translation mode.
    inValueBOOL True - means that plugin is dpi aware, coordinates translation mode is switched off.

    What changes are required on plugin side?
    To make your plugin dpi aware - you should update all used images. Each image should be specified in few resolutions: for 100%, 125%, 150%, 175% and 200% scale factors. Of course, you can ignore some of these resolutions, in this case, frame work will scale images by itself. Use the IAIMPDPIAware interface to define source DPI of the IAIMPImage or IAIMPUIImageList.

    The IAIMPUIFormEvents2.OnChangeScale event occurs when IAIMPUIForm scales. Plugin should handle this event and update glyphs and image list for all children controls by most suitable images. Current DPI value can be determined by IAIMPDPIAware manifest that has been implemented on IAIMPUIForm level. You need to update image resources in your plugins.

    IAIMPUIForm
    Description
    IAIMPUIForm is top-level window, that used as container for all another controls and non-visual objects.

    Note that unlike to other API interfaces, the ARC is not used here. Form will be destroyed automatically when user close it, or if plugin call Close or Release methods of the form's interface. Make sure that all references to the form is cleared before destroy the form, otherwise - plugin can be crashed.

    Form has two display modes: top-level / children window.

  • AIMPUI_FLAGS_BORDERSTYLE_SINGLE - normal window without an ability to resize it
  • AIMPUI_FLAGS_BORDERSTYLE_DIALOG - dialog window without an ability to resize it, does not have application icon and minimize / maximize buttons
  • AIMPUI_FLAGS_BORDERSTYLE_TOOLWINDOW - tool window without an ability to resize it

    Description
    IAIMPUIGroupBox provides an ability to create group container for other controls.
    Parent
    IAIMPPropertyList — IAIMPUIControl — IAIMPUIWinControl — IAIMPUIGroupBox
    Properties
    Following properties are available for methods of IAIMPPropertyList interface:

    AIMPUI_GROUPBOX_PROPID_AUTOSIZE
    Calculate size of elements automatically during its content size. 0 - auto size is switched off (default value).
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMPUI_GROUPBOX_PROPID_BORDERS
    0 or combination of following flags:
    + AIMPUI_FLAGS_BORDER_LEFT
    + AIMPUI_FLAGS_BORDER_TOP
    + AIMPUI_FLAGS_BORDER_RIGHT
    + AIMPUI_FLAGS_BORDER_BOTTOM
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMPUI_GROUPBOX_PROPID_CAPTION
    TypeIAIMPString
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsObject(ID, IID_IAIMPString, ..)
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsObject(ID, <IAIMPString>)
    AIMPUI_GROUPBOX_PROPID_TRANSPARENT
    0 - background is opaque.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMPUI_GROUPBOX_PROPID_PADDING
    Padding between control's borders and children controls (children controls must be auto-aligned - the Alignment property must be set to value different from ualNone). Default: 5. Since v6.0
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMPUI_GROUPBOX_PROPID_CHECKMODE
    This property provides an ability to switch on the check box in the header of group.

  • AIMPUI_CHECKMODE_NONE - check box is hidden
  • AIMPUI_CHECKMODE_CUSTOM - check box is visible
  • AIMPUI_CHECKMODE_TOGGLE_ENABLED - check box is visible, and switches the AIMPUI_CONTROL_PROPID_ENABLED property of children controls
  • AIMPUI_CHECKMODE_MINIMIZE - check box is visible, changing the state shows/hide group's content and adjust it height automatically(since 6.0)
    • Changing the check box state can be processed via IAIMPUIChangeEvents.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    AIMPUI_GROUPBOX_PROPID_CHECKED
    State of check box in header of group box (if value of the AIMPUI_GROUPBOX_PROPID_CHECKMODE is different from 0):
    Can be one of following values:
    • AIMPUI_CHECKSTATE_UNCHECKED
    • AIMPUI_CHECKSTATE_CHECKED
    • AIMPUI_CHECKSTATE_MIXED
    Changing the check box state can be processed via IAIMPUIChangeEvents.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    WriteIAIMPPropertyList.SetValueAsInt32
    Events
    IAIMPUIChangeEvents occurs when the AIMPUI_GROUPBOX_PROPID_CHECKED has been changed
    Creating the instance
    Instance must be created via the <IAIMPServiceUI>.CreateControl method.

    Control is top-aligned at parent control by default, to change it placement use the SetPlacement method.

    Control will be destroyed automatically with IAIMPUIForm that contains the control.

    IAIMPUIMode
    Description
    IAIMPUIMode provides an access to UI display settings.
    Properties
    Following properties are available for methods of IAIMPPropertyList interface:

    AIMPUI_MODE_PROPID_ACCENT
    Accent Color, in the ARGB format, 0 - accent is not specified.
    We recommend to use the IAIMPUIColorSchema for easy and correct theming.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    AIMPUI_MODE_PROPID_DPI
    Custom scaling factor of app's UI, in dpi (96 dpi = 100%).
    0 - if custom scaling factor is not set, actual scaling factor must be calculated according to OS settings.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32
    AIMPUI_MODE_PROPID_STYLE
    Can determine displaying style (Day or Night).
    Can be one of the following values: AIMPUI_STYLE_LIGHT / AIMPUI_STYLE_DARK.
    TypeInteger
    ReadIAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsInt32

    Creating the instance
    You can take a reference to the interface via <IAIMPServiceUI>.QueryInterface.

    Notifications
    On change the UI display settings, framework will broadcast the AIMP_MSG_EVENT_UI_MODE message.

    Real file name of audio file.
    Property can be not set if real file name is not exists or file name is same to file name of file-container. In this case the IAIMPPropertyList.GetValueAsObject method must return the E_NOTIMPL value.

    Example 1:
      CUE sheet is presented as separate file - C:\Music\Track.cue. So, name of virtual file will looks like C:\Music\Track.cue:1. In this case, the AIMP_VIRTUALFILE_PROPID_AUDIOSOURCEFILE property will return name of audio file, C:\Music\Track.mp3 for example.

    Example 2:
      CUE sheet is embedded and stored in file tags. So, name of virtual file will looks like C:\Music\Track.mp3:1. In this case, the AIMP_VIRTUALFILE_PROPID_AUDIOSOURCEFILE property is not required and the GetValueAsObject method returns E_NOTIMPL.

    Introduction
    AIMP provides two different API types for developers - Local and Remote.

    The Local API is provided for plugins, which are Dynamic Linking Libraries (DLL) and located in the sub folder of the "AIMP\Plugins" folder. This type of API provide a maximal possibilities to interact with the application.

    The Remote API is limited version of the Local API, and provided for another applications. This API must not be used in plugins.
    © Artem Izmaylov, 2006-2026

    Using third-party libraries in Linux
    If the plugin uses a third-party library that is not included in the OS's default distribution, you must use dynamic loading:
  • Linux does not search for statically linked modules in the folder with the library that calls them
  • AIMP does not provide options for installing/removing libraries from shared folders
  • Dynamic loading/unloading must occur in IAIMPPlugin.Initialize/IAIMPPlugin.Finalize
  • If the dynamic loading failed - the plugin can notify the player about unavailability by returning E_FAIL to IAIMPPlugin.Initialize
    • See also

    Working with strings
    Linux
    In Linux, all strings are represented as an array of bytes in UTF8 encoding, rather than UTF16 as in Windows.
    Nuances
    Working with strings in multibyte encodings requires special attention to a number of nuances that need to be taken into account:
    • In UTF8, a single character can occupy from 1 to 8 bytes (1-8 elements of IAIMPString).
      The letters of the English alphabet take up 1 byte, all others take up more than 1 byte.
      Accordingly, indexing by elements is not equal to indexing by characters in most cases.
      The affected API is IAIMPString.Get / IAIMPString.Set
    • In UTF16, a single character can take up 2 or 4 bytes (1 or 2 IAIMPString elements).
      In most cases, a character fits into 1 IAIMPString.
      Accordingly, indexing by elements may not coincide with indexing by symbols.
      Affected API: IAIMPString.Get / IAIMPString.Set
    • Trimming a byte array by an arbitrary offset can split a multibyte character into parts, resulting in incorrect data.
      Affected API: IAIMPString.Delete
    • The length of a string is the number of bytes, not the number of characters
      Affected API: IAIMPString.GetLength
    • When concatenating strings, it is important to ensure that each fragment is a valid utf8/utf16 sequence and that there are no "trimmed" characters at the boundaries.
      Affected API: IAIMPString.Insert

    If you need to work with a string character by character, it is recommended to use specialized libraries for utf8/utf16.
    © Artem Izmaylov, 2006-2026
    Free Audio Player
    www.aimp.ru
    Common Terms
    Common terms
    AIMP allows to work with one or few playlist, wherein all playlists divided into two types - loaded and unloaded. Loaded playlists are displayed in the application, unloaded are displayed in playlists manager and not loaded to the memory.
    Storing
    All playlists, regardless of how they were created - opened from external source or created via AIMP, are stores in the profile folder in the *.aimppl format.

    So, player will creates local copy in the profile folder for all opened external playlists and will work with it.
    Autoname
    The Autoname is used if name is not specified for playlist. Autoname is calculated based on content of the playlist - name of parent folder for all files is taken.
    View Settings
    In additional to global playlists settings, AIMP provides an ability to customize view settings for each playlist individually. Plugin has access to individual settings only.
    Cursors
    Each playlist contains additional information about the playback position - index of playing track (PlayingIndex), and playback cursor (PlaybackCursor).

    PlaybackCursor is cursor of internal playback queue, it does not take custom queue and plugins into account. Value of cursor point to the PlaybackQueueIndex property of playing track, and does not equals to item index.

    PlayingIndex is an absolute index of playing item in playlist. Note that each playlist has own PlayingIndex value. If you want to access to playing playlist use the IAIMPServicePlaylistManager.GetPlayingPlaylist method.
    See Also

    Plugins folder structure
    Plugins folder structure
    All plugins has been placed in <PluginsPath> folder. You can get full path via IAIMPCore.GetPath service with AIMP_CORE_PATH_PLUGINS parameter.

    Each plugin has own work folder that must contains all required files for correct working of plugin, except user settings.

    If plugin has own localization files it must place it in the Langs sub folder of work folder in *.lng format. Localizations will automatically loaded into common stack by the app. An access to common localization stack provided by IAIMPServiceMUI service.

    Common structure:
    <PluginsPath>\<Plugin Name>\Langs\*.lng
    <PluginsPath>\<Plugin Name>\<Plugin Name>.dll     (Windows 32-bit)
    <PluginsPath>\<Plugin Name>\x64\<Plugin Name>.dll (Windows 64-bit)
    <PluginsPath>\<Plugin Name>\x64\<Plugin Name>.so  (Linux 64-bit)

    User settings
    Where plugin must store user settings?
    To prevent issues with access rights and to make the backup / synchronizing procedure easier, plugin must store all settings in common configuration file. An access to it is provided by IAIMPServiceConfig service.

    Remark. If plugin is using data bases or another data which size more than 1 KBytes - plugin must store it as separate file in user's profile folder to prevent performance issues. Path to user's profile folder can be retrieved via IAIMPCore.GetPath method with AIMP_CORE_PATH_PROFILE parameter.

    Information about the playable file
    Description
    AIMP provides an access to information about the playing file for external application via File Mapping.

    Mapped file name is AIMPRemoteAccessClass and it has a fixed size that is equal to AIMPRemoteAccessMapFileSize constant.

    File contains TAIMPRemoteFileInfo structure, after it few arrays of unicode (UTF16) characters are placed, which contained information about the track: Album, Artist, Year, File Name, Genre and Title.

    Length of each array is defined in the TAIMPRemoteFileInfo structure, for example: <TAIMPRemoteFileInfo>.AlbumLength, <TAIMPRemoteFileInfo>.GenreLength and etc.

    Overview
    Limitations
    Remote API is available for Windows OS only!
    Interaction Scheme
    Interaction between the player and external application is based on exchanging by messages via native mechanism of Windows OS.

    The player creates invisible window with AIMPRemoteAccessClass class on startup. It provide an ability to exchange by messages with external applications.
    Definitions
    All definitions are located in the apiRemote.pas / apiRemote.h
    © Artem Izmaylov, 2006-2026
    Free Audio Player
    www.aimp.ru
    Subscribe to events
    Warning
    Subscribing mechanism is working for 32-bit applications only



    Subscribing to events
    Subscribing / unsubscribing from events implemented via special commands: AIMP_RA_CMD_REGISTER_NOTIFY and AIMP_RA_CMD_UNREGISTER_NOTIFY.

    External program should put own window handle as LParam, player will sent WM_AIMP_NOTIFY message to it. WParam of this message will contains Event ID (see "Events" section).



    Example:
      Window = FindWindow(AIMPRemoteAccessClass, null);
      ...
      // Subscribing 
      SendMessage(Window, WM_AIMP_COMMAND, AIMP_RA_CMD_REGISTER_NOTIFY, Form1.Handle);

      // Unsubscribing 
      SendMessage(Window, WM_AIMP_COMMAND, AIMP_RA_CMD_UNREGISTER_NOTIFY, Form1.Handle);


      // Handling events:
      TForm1 = class(TForm)
      protected
        procedure WMAIMPNotify(var Message: TMessage); message WM_AIMP_NOTIFY;
      end;

      procedure TForm1.WMAIMPNotify(var Message: TMessage);
      begin
        case Message.WParam of
          AIMP_RA_NOTIFY_TRACK_START:
            // do something
          AIMP_RA_NOTIFY_TRACK_INFO:
            // do something
          AIMP_RA_NOTIFY_PROPERTY:
            case Message.LParam of
              AIMP_RA_PROPERTY_PLAYER_POSITION:
                // do something
            end;
        end;
      end;

    © Artem Izmaylov, 2006-2026
    Free Audio Player
    www.aimp.ru
    Working with services
    Access to services
    An access to services provided via <IAIMPCore>.QueryInterface that inherited from IUnknown interface.

    Warning! Do not forget to check function result, requested service can be inaccessible!
    Access to non built-in services
    In cases when you use services that provided by another plugin, you should take into account that required plugin can be loaded after your. According to this, required to you service can be inaccessible during your plugin initialization. In this case you should process AIMP_SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION_SERVICE_ADDED notification in the IAIMPPlugin.SystemNotification method handler.
    Recommendations
    An accessibility of service is fickle - services can be switched on / switched off dynamically. If plugin will try to access to method of already destroyed interface - it can crash. To prevent situations like that we recommend you:


    1. Does not save references to services: if you need some service - get reference, work with it, and release it. For example:
    if Succeeded(<IAIMPCore>.QueryInterface(IID_IAIMPServiceVersionInfo, AVerInfo)) then
    try
      // do something
    finally
      AVerInfo := nil;
    end;
    2. In some situations you can urgent need to store reference to the service. In this case, you should process the IAIMPPlugin.SystemNotification notification. Plugin must check all stored references and release those that equals to the removing. Otherwise it can crash.

    3. Note that plugin can be loaded by Audio Converter or Tag Editor tool. You should check on plugin initialization if all required built-in services are available. If some services are not available plugin may return an error code - AIMP will mark this plugin as unused.
    © Artem Izmaylov, 2006-2026
    Free Audio Player

    inReserved2Int64 Reserved, must be set to 0

    TAIMPUIControlPlacement
    Common
    TAIMPUIControlPlacement contains a placement settings for the control.

    Player's engine provides few ways to place the control:
    1. Absolution positioning (used properties: Bounds)
    2. Positioning via anchors (used properties: Anchors, Bounds)
    3. Positioning with aligning (used properties: Alignment, AlignmentMargins, Bounds)
    Description
    TAIMPUIControlPlacement
    varAlignmentTAIMPUIControlAlignment One of following values:
    + ualNone - alignment is not used
    + ualTop - aligning by top side
    + ualBottom - aligning by bottom side
    + ualLeft - aligning by left side
    + ualRight - aligning by right side
    + ualClient - control will use all free space for placement
    varAlignmentMarginsTRect Offsets from the neighbors, 0 or positive values only. Property is used when the Alignment property is different from ualNone.
    varAnchorsTRect Anchor state for each side. 0 - anchor is not used. Property is used when the Alignment is set to ualNone.
    varBoundsTRect Absolute position of the control.
    Creating the instance
    Instance must be created via the <IAIMPServiceUI>.CreateControl method.

    Control is top-aligned at parent control by default, to change it placement use the SetPlacement method.

    Control will be destroyed automatically with IAIMPUIForm that contains the control.

    Summary

    TAIMPVisualData
    TAIMPVisualData
    This structure contains visualization data that needed for frame rendering
    Note: data was calculated before the volume, balance and anti-clipping filters were applied.
    inPeaks(2)Single An array of two elements of Single (32-bit floating point value) type.
    Current signal level in left and right channels [0.0 .. 1.0 .. infinity], where 1.0 is equals to 0 dB
    inSpectrum(3)TAIMPVisualDataSpectrum An array of three elements of TAIMPVisualDataSpectrum type.
    0 - spectrum of left channel
    1 - spectrum of right channel
    2 - spectrum of both channels

    This field is populated only if the extension returns the AIMP_VISUAL_FLAGS_RQD_DATA_SPECTRUM flag in the GetFlags method.
    inWaveForm(2)TAIMPVisualDataWaveform An array of two elements of TAIMPVisualDataWaveform type.
    Source data of left and right channels in wave-form.

    This field is populated only if the extension returns the AIMP_VISUAL_FLAGS_RQD_DATA_WAVEFORM flag in the GetFlags method.
    inSampleRateInteger Current sampling rate, since v6.0
    © Artem Izmaylov, 2006-2026

    VarValue
    Description
    A special wrapper type that implements a cross-platform analogue of the Variant type used in the AIMP API.
    Interaction with the type instance should be done exclusively through special functions defined in the apiTypes module:
    Methods
    VarValueInit
    Creates a new instance of VarValue-type
    inValue? Source value, can be on of following types: Int32, Int64, Double, String (PChar)
    outResultVarValue
    VarValueFree
    Destroys the VarValue-type instance and releases all it resources
    varValueVarValue
    VarValueNull
    Returns the VarValue-type without value, that can indicate unknown or missing data. It is not necessary to destroy the returned instance using VarValueFree.
    outResultVarValue
    VarValueCopy
    Creates a copy of VarValue. The copy must be finalized using VarValueFree
    inValueVarValue
    outResultVarValue
    VarValueIsXXX
    Check type of source value inside the VarValue-container
    inValueVarValue
    outResultBoolean
    VarValueToXXX
    Returns source value from VarValue-container in specified format. If requested format is not equal to source format, the value will be automatically converter to requested format.
    inValueVarValue
    outResult?
